From the grill

Photos from the restaurant’s own Google listing.

A garden in the centre of Larnaca

Ithaki Garden opened its garden in June 2019, at Zinonos Kitieos 64 in the centre of Larnaca. Tables stand under trees and strings of lights, the kitchen cooks Greek: cold and hot meze, salads, grilled octopus and the fish of the day.

Open Tuesday to Friday from three in the afternoon, Saturday and Sunday from one, always until eleven. Monday closed.

What guests say

Two of 2,241 Google reviews, 4.6 stars on average.

Amélie Gorry · Google review
